Class Smugglers

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.Smugglers
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardInterface, Serializable
public class Smugglers extends Card implements Serializable
Class that manages the single card smugglers In order of position, starting from the leader, each trucker decides which double cannon wants to activate, using batteries, for the calculation of the cannon power. The first trucker that has a cannon power which is higher than the smugglers one, defeat them and decide if he/she wants, losing days of flight, to gain goods. If the trucker's cannon power is equal to the smugglers' one, nothing happens to the trucker, but the smugglers continue to attack For all the defeated truckers, they have to lose some of their most valuable goods.
